situations.title: 심인성 쇼크 초기 사정
situations.tagline: I can't catch my breath and my chest feels so heavy — am I going to be okay?
situations.brief: 저혈압, 폐울혈, 저관류 소견을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm checking your breathing, blood pressure, and circulation.
I can hear some fluid in your lungs, so we'll help with that.
I'm right here and I'll keep the team updated.

situations.title: 강심제 주입 준비
situations.tagline: Can you set up the dobutamine drip and get him on continuous monitoring?
situations.brief: 도부타민이나 밀리논의 농도를 확인하고 모니터를 준비해 강심제 주입을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll confirm the dobutamine concentration against the order.
He needs continuous cardiac and blood pressure monitoring.
I'll start low and titrate to his response.

situations.title: 12유도 심전도 신속 확보
situations.tagline: He's having chest pain — grab a 12-lead right away, please.
situations.brief: 12유도 심전도를 신속히 확보하고 허혈 변화를 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll get a 12-lead ECG right now.
I'm looking for any ST changes that suggest ischemia.
I'll show this to the physician immediately.

situations.title: 폐부종 체위·산소 협조
situations.tagline: Sitting up like this helps me breathe a little — can you turn the oxygen up?
situations.brief: 좌위를 취하고 산소화를 지원해 폐부종 환자의 호흡을 돕습니다.
keyPhrases: Let's sit you upright to make breathing easier.
I'm turning up your oxygen and watching your levels.
Tell me if you feel any more short of breath.

situations.title: 수분 균형·체중 모니터
situations.tagline: You're weighing me again and writing down everything I drink — why so strict?
situations.brief: I/O와 부종을 추적해 수분 균형과 체중을 모니터하세요.
keyPhrases: We track your fluids in and out to protect your heart.
Daily weights tell us if fluid is building up.
I'm checking your legs for any swelling.

situations.title: 말초 관류·모틀링 관찰
situations.tagline: My knees have these blotchy purple patches now — should I be worried?
situations.brief: 말초 관류와 모틀링 정도를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Those mottled patches can be a sign of poor circulation.
I'm checking how far up your legs the mottling goes.
I'll report any changes to the team right away.

situations.title: 밀리논과 도부타민 선택 상황
situations.tagline: His pressure's borderline — do we go with milrinone or stick with dobutamine?
situations.brief: 혈압과 부정맥 위험을 고려해 밀리논과 도부타민 중 적절한 강심제를 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: Milrinone can drop his pressure more, so we watch that.
Dobutamine may raise his heart rate and trigger arrhythmias.
Let's pick based on his pressure and rhythm right now.

situations.title: 정맥 이뇨제 적정
situations.tagline: Let's give IV furosemide and see how her urine output responds.
situations.brief: 전부하를 줄이도록 정맥 이뇨제를 적정하고 소변 반응을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll give the IV diuretic and track her urine output closely.
We're aiming to offload the extra fluid from her lungs.
I'll watch her potassium and blood pressure as she diureses.

situations.title: 심근경색 후 저혈압 관리
situations.tagline: He's hypotensive after his MI — how do we support him without undoing the reperfusion?
situations.brief: 재관류와 승압의 균형을 맞춰 심근경색 후 저혈압을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: His pressure is low after the MI, so we support it carefully.
We want perfusion without overworking the injured heart.
I'll monitor his rhythm and pressure continuously.

situations.title: IABP 삽입 전 준비·설명
situations.tagline: They said they're putting a balloon pump in his groin — what exactly does that do?
situations.brief: IABP의 목적과 합병증을 가족에게 설명하고 삽입을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: The balloon pump helps his heart push blood more easily.
It sits in a large artery and works with each heartbeat.
We'll watch the insertion site and his leg closely afterward.

situations.title: IABP 타이밍·증강 파형 확인
situations.tagline: Can you check the augmentation on the IABP waveform — is the timing set right?
situations.brief: IABP 증강 파형을 해석하고 타이밍이 적절한지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: The augmentation should come right after the dicrotic notch.
If the timing is off, the support won't be effective.
I'll adjust the trigger and recheck the waveform.

situations.title: IABP 다리 허혈·출혈 감시
situations.tagline: The leg with the pump feels numb and cold — is that supposed to happen?
situations.brief: IABP 삽입부의 다리 허혈과 출혈 등 합병증을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm checking the pulses and color in that leg regularly.
Tell me right away if it feels more numb or painful.
I'm also watching the insertion site for any bleeding.

situations.title: 우심부전 동반 관리
situations.tagline: His right heart is struggling too — how do we manage his preload and lung pressures?
situations.brief: 전부하와 폐혈관 저항을 고려해 우심부전 동반 상황을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: His right ventricle is failing, so preload balance is delicate.
We avoid anything that raises his pulmonary pressures.
I'll watch his CVP and oxygenation closely.

situations.title: 강심제 이탈 시도
situations.tagline: They're lowering the heart medicine now — is his heart getting stronger?
situations.brief: 강심제를 감량하며 저관류 재발을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: We're slowly lowering the medication as his heart holds steady.
I'll watch for any signs his circulation is slipping.
We reduce it gradually to keep him safe.

situations.title: 기계보조 중 항응고 모니터
situations.tagline: Her ACT is due — where are we with the anticoagulation on the device?
situations.brief: 기계보조 중 ACT와 aPTT를 관리해 항응고를 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll draw the ACT and adjust the heparin per protocol.
We keep her in the target range to prevent clots and bleeding.
I'm watching the circuit and her for any bleeding.

situations.title: IABP 콘솔 경보·풍선 파열 위기
situations.tagline: There's blood in the balloon tubing and the console's alarming — I think it's ruptured!
situations.brief: IABP 풍선 파열 위기에 즉각 대응하고 의사를 호출하세요.
keyPhrases: There's blood in the tubing — the balloon may have ruptured.
I'm stopping the pump and calling the physician now.
We need to prepare to remove or replace the balloon.

situations.title: 불응성 심인성 쇼크 ECMO 고려
situations.tagline: He's not responding to the balloon pump or drips — it's time to call ECMO.
situations.brief: 불응성 심인성 쇼크에서 VA-ECMO로의 에스컬레이션을 준비하고 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: He's failing despite the IABP and inotropes.
We should activate the VA-ECMO team now.
I'll prepare the bedside and brief the family.

situations.title: 심실빈맥·세동 동반 급변
situations.tagline: He's in VT and losing his pulse — charge the defibrillator!
situations.brief: 심실빈맥·세동 동반 급변 시 제세동과 소생을 수행하세요.
keyPhrases: He's in VT and pulseless — start compressions.
Charge to 200 and clear the bed.
Resume CPR right after the shock.

situations.title: 기계보조 중 급성 출혈
situations.tagline: She's bleeding from the cannula site and she's fully anticoagulated — what do we do?
situations.brief: 기계보조 중 항응고와 수혈의 균형을 맞춰 급성 출혈 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: She's bleeding at the cannula site while anticoagulated.
Hold the heparin and get blood ready.
I'm holding pressure and calling the physician.

situations.title: 기계보조 환자 이송 관리
situations.tagline: We need to move him to the cath lab on the balloon pump — let's plan this transport carefully.
situations.brief: 기계보조 환자를 cath lab이나 수술실로 안전하게 이송하도록 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm the pump, drips, and portable monitor before we move.
Everyone knows their role for the transport.
I'll call ahead so the cath lab is ready for him.

situations.title: 회복 불가 심부전 목표 전환
situations.tagline: If his heart can't recover, what options does he really have left?
situations.brief: 완화의료와 이식 상담을 포함해 회복 불가 심부전의 목표 전환을 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: His heart isn't recovering the way we hoped.
We can talk about a transplant evaluation or comfort-focused care.
Let's find the path that fits what matters most to him.
goals: 회복 불가 상황의 목표 전환을 소통한다
